verdict.rationale: Exa ships its own agent that takes delegated tasks. Exa Agent runs async multi-step research, list-building and enrichment, returning grounded answers or schema-validated JSON, and can also be invoked via MCP. Websets lets users hand off a natural-language query in the no-code dashboard, and it searches, verifies and enriches results automatically. However, this is mainly an API-driven task agent rather than an interactive assistant inside the product UI, and hands-on Websets reports show weak accuracy (about 30/70 relevant matches) and results stuck on 'Verifying'. Missing for 10: an interactive in-app assistant experience, evidence of reliable task completion, independent corroboration of Exa Agent itself.
